summary: Corporacion America Airports S.A. (CAAP) filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary Inframerica entered a Transition Amendment Agreement with ANAC to renegotiate the Brasilia airport concession. Key changes include replacing a fixed concession fee with a variable one, Infraero's exit from Inframerica's capital (CAAP holds 51%, Infraero 49%), adding 10 regional airports, and requiring additional investments. A fast-track public tender for 100% of Inframerica shares is required by December 2026; CAAP intends to participate. If no bids, the amended concession automatically grants to Inframerica. Material change in economic equilibrium drives this court-ordered restructuring. Watch for tender outcome and regulatory clearance.
